questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if Bright & Duggan (including related entities such as Johns Lyng Group and interests of Pacific Equity Partners) and Civium are close competitors and there are not many alternatives or if one is a major supplier to competitors of the other.
Identify other key suppliers of building and facilities management and/or strata management services (i) nationally and (ii) specifically in the Australian Capital Territory.
Explain how often customers review building and facilities management and/or strata management service providers and what is involved in switching provider.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with Bright & Duggan and/or Civium.
